algorithm: After U_target/E_paired freeze, sort immutable spatial group IDs by SHA256(seed|group_id), then allocate whole groups to development, validation and held-out according to a separately approved ratio while preserving strata balance.
fallback: STRATIFIED_SAMPLE requires evidence that exhaustive execution exceeds the frozen cost ceiling and separate user approval.
grouping: spatially contiguous building groups with multipart/source-model groups kept together

phase_contract.P2_P3_pool: same development plus validation building pool
phase_contract.P4: first access to all frozen held-out buildings for C1-C5
